text:
sam (oncall): Heads-up — we're seeing a sustained spike in 502/504 and client timeouts from hosted inference in us-west-2 starting ~08:40 UTC. Error rate ~4-6x normal and p95 token latency up ~2.1s. Opening this thread for containment + customer comms.
alice - eng-runtime: Confirmed. I can see increased 502s on the edge gateway and a pattern of backend inference timeouts. Recent runtime patch (kernel selector) rolled 08:25 UTC to canary and promoted at 08:30. Reverting canary now.
kevin - eng-sre: Rolling back the kernel selector promotion from 08:30 -> initiating rollback to previous config. Will update LB health checks to 10s probe interval during rollback so we don't thrash.
maria - support: We have 3 customers in high-impact group: AtlasFinance, Shoplanes, and EduSmart. AtlasFinance hit 15% API failures starting 08:42 (their session id: sess-AT-8923). They've opened a ticket and asked for ETA.
tina - customer-success: I'll draft a short message to AtlasFinance acknowledging the issue and that we're actively rolling back & mitigating. Will hold for a confirmed ETA before sending.
evan - product: Any chance this is related to the session affinity change from last week? We had a change that altered keepalive behavior.
alice - eng-runtime: Good call — the new kernel selector path also changed some connection reuse heuristics. Reverting now should restore previous behavior. Rollback started 08:48 UTC.
deploy-bot: Detected rollback job: runtime-selector v3.2.1 -> v3.1.8 (initiated by kevin) - job id rollback-6712348901-1
kevin - eng-sre: I'm also temporarily increasing routing to spare-capacity pool and disabling an aggressive circuit-breaker rule for 15m while we verify rollback.
sam (oncall): Please capture a few repro traces for AtlasFinance session id above before/after rollback, and paste stdout logs here.
alice - eng-runtime: Attaching trimmed log snippet (error lines only):

```
08:41:58.123 ERROR gateway: downstream 502 client=request_id=abc123 path=/v1/generate err=backend-timeout seq=47
08:42:01.890 WARN runtime: kv-cache-miss model=redwood-base seq=50 cache_latency=12ms
08:42:03.451 ERROR runtime: inference-timeout model=redwood-base duration=11.8s request_id=abc123
```

alice - eng-runtime: After rollback complete at 08:53, I see error rate dropping in the next 3 minutes.
kevin - eng-sre: Observability check: p50/p95 back to baseline by 08:56. I'm going to re-enable circuit-breaker with a higher threshold and keep it monitored.
maria - support: AtlasFinance update: they saw errors from 08:42-08:56, their retries recovered after 08:57. They've asked for root cause and actions to prevent recurrence.
tina - customer-success: I'll send a conservative note: "We experienced elevated 5xx and timeouts in us-west between 08:40–08:56 UTC due to a runtime selector change; the team rolled back the change and services stabilized. We're investigating the root cause and will follow up with a postmortem." Anyone object?
evan - product: Looks good. Add "underway: add stronger canary gating + perf checks for selector promotions" as a bullet.
kevin - eng-sre: Actionable immediate follow-ups I propose now:
- run full canary regression for kernel selector in staging with long tail latency tests
- add a canary hold with traffic ramp gating (require 5m steady-state before promotion)
- add an alert on selector promotion with post-deploy p95 smoke tests

alice - eng-runtime: Agreed. I'll own the first two (canary regression + gating). Expected ETA for gating changes: EOW (Friday) if no other priorities.
sam (oncall): I'll own the postmortem doc and timeline. I'll create a minimal incident timeline + root-cause analysis doc and ping the execs. Needs owner for postmortem write-up and remediation tracking.
ect: who volunteers as postmortem owner?
kevin - eng-sre: I can be the PM for the postmortem — I'll coordinate notes with alice and maria. Assigning to kevin.
maria - support: I'll compile impacted customers list and include per-customer session ids + logs. Will add AtlasFinance's ticket ref: TCK-3849.
tina - customer-success: I'll handle outbound comms follow-ups for AtlasFinance and Shoplanes once we have a short RC summary.
evan - product: Please add a retro item to review keepalive/session affinity interactions with selector changes — likely product + runtime pairing.
kevin - eng-sre: A couple of mitigation items before we wrap this thread:
- add a temporary rule to prefer fallback model variant for requests > 8s to avoid full 502s
- tighten autoscaler headroom for us-west by +20% to reduce saturation on quick spikes

alice - eng-runtime: Implementing fallback rule now; pushing config to routing layer (expected 2m to propagate).
deploy-bot: Config push: routing.fallback.threshold=8s (operator alice) - id cfg-6712348901-2
alice - eng-runtime: Fallback is live. Monitoring metrics.
kevin - eng-sre: Metrics show client 5xx back to baseline, p95 stable.
sam (oncall): Great work everyone. Postmortem owner @kevin — please ping when the doc is ready and include action item owners. I'll schedule a 30m write-up sync tomorrow 09:30 UTC.
kevin - eng-sre: Will do. Drafting postmortem now; expected first pass in 3 hours. Action items assigned in doc will be alice (canary gating), kevin (alerts + autoscaler), tine (customer comms) — tina?
tina - customer-success: yes, I'll be on comms.

— end thread —
